description: This file defines the parseCSV class, a PHP library for parsing, manipulating, and outputting CSV data with advanced features such as auto-detection of delimiters, conditional filtering, and encoding conversions.

classes.name: parseCSV
classes.description: A PHP class providing methods to parse CSV files or strings, modify data, auto-detect delimiters, handle encoding, and output CSV data. It supports sorting, filtering by conditions, and saving modified data back to files.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the class and optionally loads and parses a CSV input.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main method to parse CSV data from a file or string input; supports setting offset, limit, and conditions.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Save the current data to a file, optionally appending or specifying specific data or fields.

methods.name: output
methods.description: Outputs CSV data directly to the browser as a downloadable file or returns the CSV string.

methods.name: encoding
methods.description: Sets character encoding conversion options for input and output data.

methods.name: auto
methods.description: Automatically detects the delimiter used in the CSV file by analyzing sample rows.

methods.name: parse_file
methods.description: Reads a CSV file and parses its content into an array.

methods.name: parse_string
methods.description: Parses a CSV string into an array, handling quotes, delimiters, and row/column structures.

methods.name: unparse
methods.description: Generates CSV-formatted strings from data arrays, supporting custom delimiters and optionally including PHP die() headers.

methods.name: load_data
methods.description: Loads data from a file or string into memory, handling encoding and special PHP cases.
